answers.reason: The junior professor holds no office giving a seat in the senate.
Budget planning involves higher office holders and does not automatically include junior professors.
Junior professors are not specified as members of appointment committees.
The junior professor holds no office granting a seat on the faculty council.
Study commissions are not automatically open to junior professors without specific assignment.
Examination boards do not include junior professors by default.
Junior professors lead research groups and participate in faculty internal research funding.
Junior professors teach and can take part in module revision working groups.
Laboratory equipment procurement is open to faculty members involved in research and teaching.
Orientation week planning is open to university members including academic staff.
